title: Vernon Full Day Guided Wine Tour with 5 Wineries
includes: Hotel & Accommodation pickup and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to the Vernon Wine Tour, hosted in the most sought after wine region in the greater Kelowna area! Be swept away by the natural beauty of Lake Country and the Scenic Sip Wine Trail, where rolling hills and epic lake and mountain views abound. 

Experience stunning vineyards, endless sunshine and jaw dropping architecture, complete with some of the tastiest wines British Columbia has to offer. Showcasing the unique terroir of the region, relax and enjoy award winning wines and culinary delights. By far our most popular wine tour, the wineries along the Scenic Sip Wine Trail are sure to impress! 

Our full day Vernon Wine Tour offers tastings at 5 award winning wineries, complete with vineyard walks and a leisurely pace.
